steps.body: Multiplying by 2 is doubling: two equal groups joined together.
steps.narration: Multiplying by 2 is doubling: two equal groups joined together.

widget.prompt: Build an array with 2 rows of 6.
widget.factorFeedback: That rectangle covers 12 squares, but not as 2 rows of 6. Build the arrangement the fact describes.
widget.lowFeedback: That is fewer than 12 squares. Keep building until the array is complete.
widget.highFeedback: That is more than 12 squares. The array should stop at 2 rows of 6.

predict.prompt: You will build 2 rows of 6. How many squares will the array hold?
predict.reveal: Two equal rows of 6 means 6 + 6 = 12. Multiplying by 2 doubles the group size — 8 adds the 6 and the 2 instead of doubling, and 6 counts only one of the two rows.
